messages:
maria: quick sync — we need the final PRD acceptance checklist for gen-api edge cases before next week's roadmap review. scope: streaming resume behavior, truncation semantics, token-limit errors, retry idempotency. who owns what?
kevin: ack. i think we should restrict to customer-impacting behaviors only: resumable streams, no duplicated tokens on retry, and unambiguous end/truncation signals.
nana: +1 to kevin, also require deterministic truncation across model families (e.g., if a prompt + max_tokens truncates, it should be reproducible when re-run). record model variant in telemetry.
nana: (typo) sorry — ana: +1 to kevin, also require deterministic truncation across model families (e.g., if a prompt + max_tokens truncates, it should be reproducible when re-run). record model variant in telemetry.
sam: devex request: publish a client contract for resume/retry flow. include: resume-token header, event ordering, how to interpret partial tool-call frames. simple example pls.
jess: CS input: customers report 2 UX bugs repeatedly — a) UI sometimes shows duplicated text after a retry/resume b) no clear signal when generation was cut (truncated) vs finished. we need explicit events for both.
kevin: draft acceptance criteria (suggested):
- [ ] resume protocol: server issues resume_token at stream cut; client may reconnect with resume_token and receive only missing tokens (no duplication).
- [ ] end-of-stream semantics: explicit terminal event 'EOS' (final=true) vs 'TRUNCATED' (final=false, reason=token_limit) with reason codes.
- [ ] retry idempotency: server honors idempotency-key for retry attempts within 60s window and returns deterministic result or explicit 'replay' token when nondeterministic.
- [ ] token-limit error mapping: 413 -> request exceeds server token budget (clear error.message), 429 -> client rate limit, 503 -> transient infra failure (eligible for backoff).
- [ ] truncation determinism: rerun with same model+params reproduces truncated boundary 95%+ of the time (measure by test harness).
- [ ] telemetry: metrics for truncated_rate, resume_success_rate, duplicate_token_rate, avg_resume_latency.
- [ ] client contract published in /docs/gen-api/resume-and-truncation.md with examples and lib snippets.
kevin: for resume header sketch:
```
POST /v1/generate
Headers:
  Idempotency-Key: <uuid>
  Resume-Token: <resume_token>  # optional, from previous stream
Body: { model, prompt, max_tokens, stream: true }
```
Server responses (streaming):
- data: token
- data: { resume_token: "abc123" }  # at cut points
- event: { type: "EOS", final: true }
- event: { type: "TRUNCATED", final: false, reason: "token_limit" }
kevin: note: resume_token must encode model+cursor+seq to allow validation server-side. not user-readable.
nana: tests: we'll add unit tests that replay recorded traces to assert no duplicates and correct resume ordering. also add a fuzz test that simulates in-flight retries.
sam: rollout plan idea: canary on 10% of traffic for 72h with strict monitoring on duplicate_token_rate and resume_success_rate. failover: route canary to compatible model variant if resume fails.
maria: prioritization decision: this is P1 for Hosted API (customer-facing), P2 for Dedicated (post-hosted), Private flagged for enterprise customers with opt-in. acceptance criteria above look good. please assign owners.
kevin: i'll own server impl + error codes. ana owns truncation determinism tests and telemetry. sam will own client contract + docs. jess will validate with top 3 customers. maria: can you add these to the roadmap PRD and mark launch criteria?
maria: will do. ask: exact SLA gating? propose: duplicate_token_rate < 0.1% and resume_success_rate > 99% for GA. OK?
jess: those numbers look reasonable to customers.
kevin: one open question: how to handle nondeterministic models (sampling). proposal: for deterministic resume we only guarantee no-duplication for deterministic sampling or when a fixed seed is provided. otherwise return 'REPLAY_REQUIRED' token and force client to fetch full output.
nana: agree. document behavior and add a test case for sampling models.
sam: I'll draft client examples for both deterministic and sampling cases.
deploy-bot: canary deploy task created: infra/task/10987 assigned to kevin (scheduled start 2025-11-05T10:00:00Z) :rocket:
kevin: noted. starting design doc PR now.
maria: perfect — thanks everyone. i'll pull these acceptance items into the PRD and ping for final review once drafted. :thumbsup:
